style: Warm, whimsical children's picture-book illustration with a soft educational-diagram feel. Bold, flat digital art with clean thick outlines, brightly saturated colors, gentle atmospheric lighting. Friendly, rounded character design. Single clear scene, no text or watermarks, no panel borders.
characters: Nora: a curious girl about 9 years old with braided hair and glasses, wearing a blue raincoat, often seen with a small notebook.
cover: Nora standing outside in a light rain holding an umbrella, looking up happily at a big sun partly behind clouds above a lake, with a faint rainbow, cheerful curious expression.
pages: Nora standing at the edge of a calm lake on a sunny day, looking thoughtfully at the water with her notebook, wondering where rain comes from.
A bright sun shining down on a lake, with wavy translucent lines of vapor visibly rising up from the water's surface into the sky, Nora watching from the shore.
Fluffy white clouds forming high in a blue sky from rising mist, small water droplet shapes gathering together inside the clouds, Nora looking up pointing excitedly.
Dark heavy rain clouds releasing rain over the same lake and surrounding hills, Nora standing under a colorful umbrella watching the rain fall.
The same lake now full and sparkling after the rain, with a rainbow arching overhead and the sun peeking out, Nora smiling and closing her umbrella.
Nora holding a small globe and smiling, with a dreamy split scene behind her showing a sandy desert with a small oasis on one side and a lush green rainforest with rain on the other.
